summaries.Romania: Romania faces mounting governance crises: the ANI integrity law collapsed in Senate over political maneuvering threatening €770M in PNRR funds, while healthcare infrastructure deteriorates with gynecological equipment dating back decades and only 24 of 83 family planning clinics receiving promised EU funding. Critical infrastructure strain continues as the Danube reaches near-1985 drought levels, forcing nuclear reactor contingencies and threatening energy security.
summaries.Healthcare: The FTC sued Hims & Hers for data privacy and billing deception while Medicaid work requirements advanced despite legal challenges, signaling intensifying regulatory scrutiny of telehealth and insurance accessibility. Healthcare innovation continues with J&J's €785M cell therapy partnership and AI-driven tools gaining traction, but systemic pressures from supply costs and workforce shortages are mounting.
summaries.Tech: Apple reported record Q3 2026 earnings (€109.4B revenue) but warned of significant supply constraints ahead and record €11.73B R&D spending, while Tim Cook marked his final earnings call before John Ternus takes over—signaling potential strategic shifts. AI breakthroughs continue across robotics, security, and enterprise tools, but regulatory scrutiny intensifies with judges skeptical of export restrictions and privacy concerns mounting.

items.title: PSD publică votul pe Legea ANI: Coaliţia PNL-USR-AUR e gata să sacrifice bani din PNRR ca să-l salveze pe Fritz
items.snippet: Partidul Social Democrat acuză, joi seară, AUR, PNL şi USR că s-au coalizat şi nu au votat Legea ANI, sacrificând 770 de milioane de euro din PNRR, „ca să-l salveze pe Dominic Fritz”.
items.line: Senate rejection of ANI integrity law over retroactive sanctions threatens €770M in PNRR funds and exposes constitutional concerns amid inter-party power plays.

items.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers over data privacy, billing practices
items.snippet: The Federal Trade Commission, along with Utah and California authorities, sued telehealth company Hims & Hers, alleging it misled consumers about privacy, billing and subscription practices.
items.line: FTC sues Hims & Hers for misrepresenting privacy, billing, and subscription practices—a critical blow to telehealth trust during rapid sector expansion.

items.title: Apple reports Q3 2026 earnings: $109.4 billion in revenue, up 16% [Charts]
items.snippet: Apple just released its earnings report for the third fiscal quarter of 2026. The company reported $109.4 billion in revenue, $29.8 billion in net profit, and $2.02 in earnings per share. Here’s the full breakdown.
items.line: Apple reports €109.4B Q3 revenue (+16% YoY) and 1.5B paid subscriptions, but warns of significant supply constraints and record €11.73B R&D spending.

items.title: Debitul Dunării scade dramatic și se apropie de recordul negativ din 1985. Ce măsuri sunt în vigoare pentru irigații
items.snippet: România traversează una dintre cele mai dificile perioade hidrologice din ultimele decenii, în condițiile în care nici în bazinul superior al Dunării nu sunt prognozate precipitații în perioada imediat următoare, potrivit Administrației Naționale „Apele Române”.
items.line: Danube water levels approach 1985 historic lows, triggering power plant contingencies and agricultural restrictions that threaten Romania's energy and food security.

items.title: Senatul a adoptat Codul Urbanismului. România evită pierderea a 972 de milioane de euro din PNRR și reduce birocrația în construcții
items.snippet: Senatul a adoptat joi Codul Amenajării Teritoriului, Urbanismului și Construcțiilor (CATUC), cunoscut drept noul Cod al Urbanismului, după ce proiectul a fost aprobat miercuri de Camera Deputaților. Legea reprezintă unul dintre jaloanele asumate de România prin Planul Național de Redresare și Rezili
items.line: Senate adoption of new Urbanization Code (CATUC) avoids €972M PNRR penalty and promises digital construction approvals to reduce bureaucracy.

items.title: Key Senate panel backs Trump’s picks for CDC, pandemic preparedness
items.snippet: In win for RFK Jr., Senate committee sends nominations of Erica Schwartz for CDC director and Sean Kaufman for ASPR to full Senate.
items.line: Senate panel advances Trump's picks for CDC director and pandemic preparedness, clearing regulatory leadership vacancies amid health security concerns.

items.title: Judge says Trump admin still lacks evidence for Anthropic ‘supply-chain risk’ label
items.snippet: A federal judge said the Trump administration has not presented enough evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply-chain risk, casting doubt on the government's ban on its AI technology.
items.line: Federal judge rejects Trump admin's 'supply-chain risk' label against Anthropic, finding insufficient evidence for AI technology export restrictions.

items.line: Meta claims AI dramatically accelerates app development, signaling shift toward AI-native product creation as competitive moat.
